blocking.title: A near re-click that R25a keeps as the same landing is told, when it lands, as a failed landing: 'its transports broke off; it came ashore away from its target' (new in R25)
blocking.evidence: critic/c38_lwt5_two_s42.json (the one aboard re-clicked 42 px below Shanghai, cell 1715,415, at hour 26: kept aboard, both land h632 at 1715.5,411.5; 364 told landedAway in its panel and an order-news row); critic/shots/c38lwt5_two_s42_notice_h632.png; critic/shots/c38lwt5_two_s42_notice_h632_panel.png; critic/c38_lwt4_two_s42.json (same, trace h632); four re-clicked 42 px south (R25c's case): all land h1241-1244, landedAway told for 364 and 367, critic/c38_lwt5_four_alls42.json, critic/shots/c38lwt5_four_alls42_notice_h1241_panel.png, critic/shots/c38lwt5_four_alls42_end.png; none at 21 px S / 14 px E / 42 px W (critic/c38_lwt4_two_s21.json, critic/c38_lwt5_two_e14.json, critic/c38_lwt5_two_w42.json) nor in run 37's one-cell cases (critic/c37_lwt2_two_near14.json). Cause read: server.ts orderNews keeps the new click as the order's target and tells landedAway beyond AT_PORT_CELLS (3) of it; R25a accepts clicks within SAME_LANDING_CELLS (2) of the goal, and Shanghai's landing land is two cells north of Shanghai.
blocking.fix: When an order is kept as the same landing (sameLanding), keep the order's target the landing it already had (or measure 'landed away' from that landing's land). AT: the two to Shanghai, the one aboard re-clicked two cells south (1715.5, 415.5) at hour 26: both land within a day and no landedAway is told; red without (364 told at h632). The four all re-clicked there: no news at the landing.
